what_a_pass_means: This manifest records what was verified, when, and by which command. A passing test_baseline_manifest means the RECORD is well-formed and tracks the live engine version. It does not re-run any of the evidence below, and it does not mean the product is correct.
rename_reason: The old name asserted that the contents described engine v63. They no longer did: the file sat at engine_version 63 while the live engine reached 75, so test_manifest_tracks_the_live_engine_baseline failed for twelve versions (F6). A baseline that has to be renamed every engine bump will not be, so it is now version-neutral and carries the version as data.

toolchain.note: Measured in the nesnative dev container on 2026-08-06. These differ from the 2026-07-10 capture, which ran on a different host (python 3.13.5, node 20.19.2, npm 9.2.0) -- recorded so a future mismatch is read as 'different machine', not 'regression'.

builder_regression.notes: 110 suites, 0 failures, re-run at this commit rather than inherited from the 2026-07-10 capture. Confirms the v76 snapshot-scope bump changed no ROM output. An earlier run of this same tree was discarded: a probe moved cfg/nes.cfg aside mid-run and broke one suite at the ld65 link step.

engine_snapshot.notes: Confirms the v76 snapshot matches HEAD. From v76 this includes tools/nes_studio_core (the server's ROM codegen); v1-v75 snapshots were taken without any Python and are not comparable (F7, closed by the v76 bump).

native_unittest.notes: PySide6 is absent in this container, so the Qt UI layer is untested here, not passing. Do not read the pass count as coverage.
known_gaps: 12 modules import PySide6 at module scope and report as collection ERRORS instead of skips; 3 more import it inside the test body and report as plain FAILURES (F3). Both are absent-dependency, not defects.
The Qt UI suite has never been run anywhere. Step 1-2 of the close-out plan covers it.

golden_rom_sha1.note: Not a stale copy. These same three values are asserted live by tools/builder-tests/run-all.mjs (GOLDEN_STOCK, GOLDEN_TEMPLATE) and tools/builder-tests/_rom-equiv.mjs (EXPECT), which run in the builder suite recorded above. They therefore still hold at engine v75.

manual_fceux_v63.carried_forward_note: Preserved verbatim from the 2026-07-10 capture. It is evidence about v63 and has NOT been repeated at v75. Twelve engine versions have landed since; three of the seven starter ROMs are known to have changed in that range (see docs/handoffs/2026-08-06-starter-fixture-rebaseline.md). Treat this as history, not as current attended coverage.
manual_fceux_v63.attestation: The product owner reports that the C and ASM files passed all relevant attended tests checked at the time.
manual_fceux_v63.limitations: The earlier manual run did not leave a case-by-case command, input-sequence, screenshot, or observation manifest. Current automated v63 coverage therefore remains the reproducible evidence; the attestation closes the attended gate without fabricating missing observations.
